title: Latency Mandala: per-route & per-model streaming vs non-streaming dashboard
creator: Liam O'Connor
description:
Goal: Build a single interactive dashboard (the 'Latency Mandala') that lets SREs, infra and runtime teams slice p50/p95/p99 latencies by model and route and compare streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. This dashboard must surface tail behavior, correlation to error rates, and provide direct trace links for high-latency cohorts so oncall can triage quickly.

Why: Existing boards are fractured by team and don’t provide an easy way to pivot from aggregate percentile trends down to traceable tail samples for debugging model- and route-specific regressions. This increases blur time during incidents and slows root cause analysis.

Scope: backend metrics enrichment, new tracing hook sampling rules, dashboard panels (histogram heatmap, percentile sparklines, cohort table with trace links), and runbook + alerts integration. Not in scope: automatic remediation and autoscaling changes (separate initiative).
acceptance_criteria: New dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 across selectable time windows (1h/6h/24h/7d) for selected model(s) and route(s)
I/O mode toggle splits metrics into streaming vs non-streaming with side-by-side comparison and percent-delta column
Heatmap panel displays latency distribution by request length bucket and kernel_exec time with hover-to-filter
Trace links present for top N slowest requests per cohort; clicking opens distributed trace with pre-applied filters
Dashboard loads within 2s for 24h window for standard team queries (per perf target)
Automated alert fires when route p99 increases > 2x baseline for 5 minutes and attaches recent top-10 trace IDs
tasks: Instrument backend: add latency labels to metrics (model_variant, route, io_mode, request_shape) in runtime-emitter v2
Add tracing hook: sample tail traces at adaptive rate (100% for >p99, 1% baseline) and attach servepath spans: 'kv_cache', 'kernel_exec', 'queue_wait'
Metrics pipeline: update metric transform in metrics-ingest to compute per-route percentiles and histogram buckets; add derived metric 'route.p99_delta'
Dashboard UX: implement panels in Console using new percentile API endpoints; include streaming split toggle and comparison column
Create SQL/ES queries and materialized views for fast cohort lookups; add precomputed top-10 slowest trace IDs per route
Alerting & Runbook: create SLO-based alert rule and simple runbook with triage steps and quick links to trace query templates
QA & Load test: verify dashboard query performance on staging with 7d synthetic dataset and validate trace link correctness
Rollout: feature flag behind 'obs.latency_mandala' and staged rollout to internal teams before 2-week public beta

notes: Trade-offs considered: full-fidelity trace sampling would be ideal but cost-prohibitive; we are adopting adaptive tail-sampling and precomputed cohorts to keep observability useful without high telemetry cost. We will revisit sampling knobs after beta. Also decided not to include automated remediation so the first iteration focuses on diagnosis speed.
